Statement of Requirements

The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), VISN 15 VA Hospital Medical Centers (VAMCs), has a requirement for the rental of inpatient beds, mattresses, and accessories (See List Below) The requirement will include all inpatient requirements of the facility along with; Spinal Cord Injury Units, and Community Living Centers located at the facilities only. Under the contract the contractor shall provide delivery, set-up, maintenance/service/repair, and pick-up of all items. Key Operator Training will also be needed for all rental items.

VISN 15 FACILITY LOCATIONS ARE:

VAMC Marion IL: 2401 W Main St. Marion IL 62959

VAMC Kansas City: 4801 Linwood Blvd, Kansas City MO 64128

VAMC St. Louis- John Cochran Division: 915 North Grand Blvd, St. Louis MO 63106

VAMC St. Louis-Jefferson Barracks Division: 1 Jefferson Barracks Drive, St. Louis MO 63125

VAMC Columbia: 800 Hospital Drive, Columbia MO 65201

VAMC Poplar Bluff: 1500 N. Westwood, Poplar Bluff MO 63901

VAMC Wichita: Dole VAMC 5500 E Kellogg, Wichita KS 67218

VAMC Topeka: 2200 Gage Blvd, Topeka KS 66622

VAMC Leavenworth: 4101 S. 4th. St. Trafficway, Leavenworth KS 66048
